CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ CardKeyword.Unplayable }` (Injury.cs:10) == `is_playable = False`. NOT Eternal and NOT Ethereal -- Injury is the plainest curse in the pool, removable and permanent in hand -- and the sim leaves both False. It also does NOT override CanBeGeneratedByModifiers, so Injury IS in the random-curse pool on both sides (the sim leaves the True default).

ctor.issue: Closed 2026-07-30 (tier-2 campaign), CONFIRMED against current source 2026-08-04: `Card.energy_cost` (`sts2_rl/cards/base.py:422-443`, was `:222-232`) short-circuits on `self._energy_cost < 0` as its first check (`base.py:433-434`), returning the raw canonical value before consulting `_free_this_turn` / `_cost_this_turn` / `_cost_this_combat` / `_cost_delta_this_turn` -- mirrors `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers`'s `if (_base < 0) return num;` short-circuit (`CardEnergyCost.cs:101-104`), which runs before any local or global modifier. Injury sets `self._energy_cost = -1` in `_init_vars` (injury.py:29), matching `base(-1, CardType.Curse, ...)`. Readers: combat play/auto-play/valid_actions/action-mask sites gate on `is_playable` first and never see -1; every global-modifier site routes through `hooks.modify_card_energy_cost`, whose dispatcher ends `return max(0, cost)`, so what is SPENT and what the observation encoder reads (`full_env.py:700-744`, was `:455-489`) are unchanged. DORMANT: every ported cost reader filters `> 0` or skips `<= 1`, and `events/infested_automaton.py` (now via `reward_pool_card_ids`, not `pool_card_ids` -- the event was refactored since this record's last audit) still excludes curses/statuses at its two call sites: `_study` filters to `CardType.POWER` (infested_automaton.py:53) and `_touch_core` filters `energy_cost == 0` (infested_automaton.py:61), and Injury's canonical cost is -1, not 0, so neither offer can surface it. New pins: test/test_unplayable_cost.py (15 tests, still present).
